title: ACK RxFrame verifier provenance is forgeable through importable bearer token
description: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py and schc/fragment.py expose an importable verifier token, callable trusted factory, and shared default binding. In-process callers/tests can mint an RxFrame accepted by production ACK handling. Remove importable bearer token/public trusted factory and require a LinkLayer-owned unforgeable provenance path; public/package APIs must not mint accepted envelopes.
